events.title: Boreal Lake, Lake Superior PP
events.thought: The boreal has a way of making every lake look like the only lake in the world.
events.photoCaption: Mirror-calm boreal lake with lone island, surrounded by black spruce and reflected sky.

events.title: Pukaskwa National Park
events.thought: Pukaskwa — one of Canada's least-visited national parks, and wild as they come.
events.photoCaption: Entrance sign at Pukaskwa National Park of Canada, gateway to wild Lake Superior country.

events.title: Driftwood Beach, Lake Superior
events.thought: Lake Superior's shores are decorated with years of driftwood — raw and beautiful.
events.photoCaption: Driftwood-strewn sandy beach on the shores of Lake Superior near Pukaskwa.
